# Has your turnover passed NZD 60,000, and when must you register for GST?

> Free New Zealand GST registration checker: enter your last 12 months of sales to see whether taxable turnover has passed NZD 60,000, test your expected turnover, and get your registration deadline. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
